Quick Start

using ValTools, CairoMakie
# Inertial oscillation at 25°N
f = 1/26.7  # cycles/hour
t = 0:1:(24*40)
u = 0.15 .* cos.(2π * f .* t)
v = 0.15 .* sin.(2π * f .* t)
spec = rotary_spectrum(u, v; dt_hours=1)
# Peak should be ~26.7 h ✓
